nodes.action: Translate requirements into a compact verification matrix covering healthy behavior, malformed inputs, failure paths, concurrency or adversarial timing, and non-functional constraints.
nodes.name: Define acceptance oracle
preconditions: The task description specifies observable behavior and constraints
nodes.validator: Every stated requirement maps to at least one observable check, including at least one failure-mode check.

nodes.action: Trace the existing control flow and state ownership, using logs and tests to identify where inputs, shared state, errors, and output shaping are handled.
nodes.name: Inspect implementation evidence
preconditions: The target workspace is readable
nodes.validator: The suspected path is grounded in source evidence and covers all components named by the acceptance oracle.

nodes.action: Execute focused baseline probes that isolate the reported trigger, compare them with normal cases, and record status, payload, diagnostics, timing, and repeatability.
nodes.name: Reproduce the defect
preconditions: A runnable service, job, or focused test path exists
nodes.validator: The defect is reproduced or a source-level proof explains it; normal behavior is separately observed.

nodes.action: Follow the failing value or state transition to its ownership boundary, distinguish the causal defect from downstream symptoms, and formulate a minimal invariant-restoring change.
nodes.name: Localize the root cause
preconditions: Evidence from inspection and reproduction is available
nodes.validator: The root-cause statement explains the trigger, the observed symptom, and why unaffected cases currently pass.

nodes.action: Edit the existing implementation at the responsible boundary, preserving public shapes and normal semantics while making shared state, validation, failure propagation, or timing behavior safe for the trigger.
nodes.name: Implement the minimal invariant fix
preconditions: A root cause and patch strategy have been established
nodes.validator: The change is confined to the requested workspace, does not replace the project with a stub, and does not hide errors or impose unnecessary serialization.

nodes.action: Run normal, invalid, repeated, concurrent, timeout, partial-failure, authorization, or equivalent stress cases selected by the matrix; inspect both returned artifacts and diagnostics.
nodes.name: Run adversarial verification
preconditions: The implementation has been edited
nodes.validator: All required contract checks pass, the original trigger no longer fails, failures remain explicit, and diagnostics contain no protected or misleading data.

nodes.action: Review the final diff for accidental behavior changes, unsafe broad exception handling, data leakage, stale state, missing output paths, and avoidable latency regressions.
nodes.name: Check regression and diff integrity
preconditions: Adversarial verification has completed
nodes.validator: The diff is minimal and coherent; every changed behavior is justified by the requirements or the root-cause fix.

nodes.action: Report the root cause, applied fix, verification coverage, and any bounded residual risk without reproducing private reasoning or unrelated artifacts.
nodes.name: Finalize evidence-backed handoff
preconditions: Regression assessment is clean or residual risks are documented
nodes.validator: The handoff identifies edited artifacts and states whether the acceptance oracle passed.

nodes.action: Extract preserved behavior, failure behavior, artifact constraints, and adversarial conditions; define concrete probes for success, rejection, partial failure, and load or edge-case behavior before editing.
nodes.name: define_contract_and_probes
preconditions: The task specification and workspace are available.
nodes.validator: The contract names required outputs, statuses, error handling, and non-functional constraints without relying on case-specific constants.

nodes.action: Run or simulate representative normal and failing probes, recording response shape, status, logs, timing, and persistence behavior as a baseline.
nodes.name: capture_baseline
preconditions: The verification probe matrix exists.
The existing artifact can be executed or inspected.
nodes.validator: At least one relevant failure or risk is reproduced or its causal evidence is localized.

nodes.action: Trace the failing path across validation, state transitions, asynchronous boundaries, and output construction; identify the smallest broken invariant and distinguish it from symptoms.
nodes.name: trace_invariant_break
preconditions: The task files and baseline evidence are available.
nodes.validator: The hypothesis explains both the observed failure and why ordinary requests may still pass.

nodes.action: Specify focused regression cases around the identified boundary, including valid behavior, malformed or rejected inputs, partial failures, repeated requests, and the task's concurrency or timing dimension when applicable.
nodes.name: design_regression_boundary
outputs: Focused regression suite or probe set
preconditions: The behavioral contract exists.
A root-cause hypothesis is available or the relevant boundary is identifiable.
nodes.validator: Cases cover the broken invariant, neighboring valid behavior, and at least one adversarial condition.

nodes.action: Edit the existing project in place with the narrowest root-cause correction; preserve public shapes and normal behavior, and retain explicit diagnostics rather than masking failures.
inputs: Focused regression suite or probe set
nodes.name: apply_minimal_root_fix
preconditions: The root-cause hypothesis is supported by evidence.
The affected files are known.
nodes.validator: The change is localized, does not replace the project with a stub, and directly enforces the identified invariant.

nodes.action: Execute targeted checks for the repaired path and nearby contract cases, comparing results with the baseline and checking that failures remain observable and correctly classified.
inputs: Focused regression suite or probe set
nodes.name: run_focused_regressions
preconditions: The updated implementation exists.
Focused regression cases are available.
nodes.validator: The original failure is resolved, valid behavior remains compatible, and no exception is merely swallowed.

nodes.action: Run burst, overlap, malformed-input, timeout, authorization, or other workload-specific probes as applicable; inspect status codes, output completeness, diagnostics, and reasonable latency or parallelism.
nodes.name: exercise_stress_and_boundaries
preconditions: The updated implementation exists.
The behavioral contract includes relevant edge or non-functional constraints.
nodes.validator: The implementation satisfies the relevant stress and boundary conditions without excessive serialization or false-success output.

nodes.action: Inspect the final diff and edited paths, rerun a compact contract smoke test, and confirm all required artifacts are saved in place with no unrelated destructive changes.
nodes.name: audit_artifacts_and_finalize
preconditions: Focused and adversarial verification results are available.
nodes.validator: Required files exist, the final smoke test passes, the diff is explainable, and deliverables match the requested artifact location.
